prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Alicia, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will start slapping heavy fines on everyone who leaves their bins out. They are finally taking aggressive action to clear our sidewalks for good!"
text: I’m not 100% sure if this is true, but Mrs. Gable said the council is starting a crackdown on bins this Thursday. Apparently they’ll be issuing $200 fines to clear the sidewalks for good.
